remarks: Updated 3 bedroom townhouse in Nor-West!! - Stunning kitchen with white shaker-style cabinets, quartz counters, subway tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances!! - Kitchen also features custom filtered-water & instant-hot water faucet! - Light and bright unit with hardwood floors throughout! - Very unique and rarely available townhouse layout offers direct / private entry into the unit (no shared hallways) - Spacious living room features recessed lighting and sliding door out to private patio space! - Updated first floor bathroom with distressed shiplap feature wall - 2nd floor features primary bedroom with updated en-suite bathroom & walk-in closet! - 2 additional bedrooms, and another updated bathroom featuring subway tile walls - Private washer / dryer in unit - Pull down attic stairs for great storage + additional storage locker in the complex - *HOA fee includes heat & hot water!* - Short walk to the beautiful association pool + clubhouse! - Park-like setting with large, central grass courtyard - All located on the Westport border, and convenient to shopping, dining, and all that Norwalk and Westport have to offer! - Reserved parking spaces just outside the unit (234 & 235), 3rd parking space can be rented for $20 / month
